Hi my name is Ashley! I am a 23 year old veterinary student at Ross University School of Veterinary Medicine! The school is located in the Caribbean on the island Saint Kitts & Nevis. 

I started making videos so people can see what my life is like here :)

Follow me on instagram: @ashleyvasel

Feel free to message me there or comment on videos if you have any questions!
